Alternating Fronts.name: Alternating Fronts
Alternating Fronts.description: The user blocks a frontal attack with a right-side ice slab, then sends left-side fire along an empty strip within eight meters to discourage pursuit until the end of their next turn. The fire warms the chilled body; it does not restore stamina. The user needs space between the fire and the people behind the slab, which cracks under heavy blows. Strain: moderate.
